Support.Community.Title: Community
Support.Community.Sub: Join the community for help, sharing works and update news.
Support.About.Intro: Viora is a local photo stylization app: import a picture, apply art-style plugins (watercolor, oil painting, low-poly and 55 more), tweak parameters, batch process, compare before/after, and keep everything in a works library. Client and plugins are fully decoupled — you decide how many styles to install, and uninstalling really deletes.
Support.About.PluginIntro: Anyone can build a Viora style plugin and publish it to the official market — a thin plugin entry class (about 30 lines) plus a manifest is all it takes:
Support.Step1: Create a .NET 8 class library referencing Viora.PluginSdk, extend VioraPluginBase and register your preset on init;
Support.Step2: Implement IStylePreset: expose tunable parameters and do the pixel work inside BuildPipeline;
Support.Step3: Write plugin.json (plugin id, name, version, entry DLL and type name);
Support.Step4: Package as a zip and drop it into the plugins folder next to the app to test locally;
Support.Step5: Submit a PR to the official plugin repo (package in packages/ + a registry.json entry); once merged it shows up for everyone.
Support.Help.PluginRepo.Sub: Browse all official & community plugin sources
Support.Faq1.Q: Why is the Stylize page empty?
Support.Faq1.A: The client ships with no styles: install style plugins from the Plugin Market and they appear in Stylize immediately; uninstalling removes them.
Support.Faq2.Q: Where do plugins live, and how do I remove them manually?
Support.Faq2.A: Plugins live in the plugins folder next to the app, one sub-folder each. Deleting a folder is exactly what the market's uninstall does — it never comes back.
Support.Faq3.Q: Why is some text still in the old language after switching?
Support.Faq3.A: A few texts (like parameter labels saved inside old works) fully switch only after a restart — the app offers to restart right away.
Support.Faq4.Q: Where do I set export format and quality?
Support.Faq4.A: Settings → Performance → Export: choose the default format (PNG/JPEG/BMP/TIFF/GIF/WebP) and JPEG quality; the export dialog also lets you switch formats anytime.
